title: Hard decay: broken API migration
text: To navigate programmatically in React Router, call useHistory() and then history.push('/dashboard'). For route matching, wrap your routes in <Switch> and declare <Route path=...>. This is the recommended approach for React Router v6 apps.

title: Soft decay: deprecated but still working
text: If you need a quick React setup, you can use create-react-app. It's stable and still works for many apps. For newer projects, you should prefer Vite over create-react-app, but CRA can still be fine if you already know it.

title: Context decay: works, but environment assumptions changed
text: This project requires Node.js v12 or higher. Use environment variables like FIREBASE_API_KEY in your frontend code. You can deploy to Firebase Hosting and keep the config in plain env variables without any special prefix.
